role: Tells the client the world spawn point at join: handleSpawnPosition sets the client player's spawn chunk and the client world info's spawn position.
scope_reason: Sent at join and on respawn or dimension change with the current dimension's world spawn (ServerConfigurationManager.java:144, 453); its only client reader is TextureCompass, and the native compass reads the server world's spawn (csrc/play/play.c live_update_renderer: spawner.spawn_x/z), which is the value the packet carries.

members.name: ctor
members.note: the decoder's ctor only: Packet.generatePacket instantiates it by reflection (newInstance) for bytes read off a socket (MessageDeserializer); the integrated server's local channel passes packet objects with no codec (NetworkManager.provideLocalClient adds only the packet_handler), so it never runs

members.name: readPacketData
members.note: byte codec; the native channel carries structs (csrc/engine/tracker.h's tracker_packet, csrc/engine/survival.h's s2c_pkt), not packets

missing: The client's spawn-chunk mirror (EntityPlayer.setSpawnChunk) and the client world info's spawn position are not tracked natively; the server's spawn point lives only in the server's world info (csrc/engine/seedworld.c).
notes: Nothing in csrc/engine reads a client-side spawn point; the join flow (csrc/engine/serverreplay.c) never queues one. idxaudit 2026-09-27: scope reason rewritten.
